name: mobile-fire
description: Hold the mobile joystick and tap Fire with a second finger; verify a projectile appears while the stick remains held and the tank moves.

jobs.name: mobile-drive-fire
keys: eval:(() => { const start = window.__tmtGame.snapshot.tanks[0].position; window.mobileFire = { start, firedWhileDriving: false }; const sample = () => { if (document.getElementById('stick-zone').classList.contains('is-active') && window.__tmtGame.snapshot.projectiles.some(p => p.owner === 0)) window.mobileFire.firedWhileDriving = true; window.mobileFire.frame = requestAnimationFrame(sample); }; sample(); })()

eval@result:(() => { cancelAnimationFrame(window.mobileFire.frame); const { start, firedWhileDriving } = window.mobileFire; const distance = Math.hypot(...window.__tmtGame.snapshot.tanks[0].position.map((v, i) => v - start[i])); if (!firedWhileDriving) throw new Error('Second-finger Fire did not shoot while the joystick was held'); if (distance < 0.1) throw new Error('Joystick did not drive the tank'); if (document.getElementById('stick-zone').classList.contains('is-active')) throw new Error('Joystick remained held after release'); return { firedWhileDriving, distance }; })()
